Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/indice-de-confianza-del-consumidor-mes-de-mayo-2026. Processing script data/spain_2026_confidence.do (Table 1: acquisition). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: CIS's own codebook codigo3565.pdf (in the microdata package) names each block outright -- 'P1 ... Adquisición para el hogar de diferentes bienes: Automóvil/moto (P1_1), Muebles para el hogar (P1_2), Electrodomésticos/ordenadores personales (P1_3), Electrodomésticos pequeños (P1_4)' -- and the questionnaire's P.1 grid lists the four goods in that same row order. The ES3565/.sav VARIABLE LABELS carry only the response-option label per dummy (P1_k_1 'Sí, él/ella ha adquirido', P1_k_2 'Sí, lo ha adquirido otra persona de su hogar', P1_k_3 'No', P1_k_8 'N.S.', P1_k_9 'N.C.'; each dummy 1 'Sí' 2 'No'), so the good is tied to the code by the codebook, not the variable labels. 4/4 goods reconciled. DERIVATION: the CIS file stores P.1 as one-hot dummies; data/spain_2026_confidence.do rebuilds one item per good named after the CIS question root (P1_k -> p1_k, number-preserving, no positional step) with resp 1 if P1_k_1==1 or P1_k_2==1, resp 2 if P1_k_3==1, else missing. Re-running that logic on 3565_num.csv reproduces the live table exactly: 12080 rows, id/item/resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences, against the local irw cache copy that table_context.R made; no new export). Live item x resp (1/2): p1_1 330/2697, p1_2 711/2311, p1_3 935/2090, p1_4 919/2087. No respondent chose both a Sí code and No for the same good, and none chose nothing. RESP / DROPPED CODES: resp 1 is an IRW collapse of two administered codes -- 'Sí, él/ella ha adquirido' (self: p1_1 204, p1_2 556, p1_3 724, p1_4 707) and 'Sí, lo ha adquirido otra persona de su hogar' (other household member: 134/183/240/233), with 8/28/29/21 respondents marking both (multiple response). option_text for resp 1 therefore carries BOTH questionnaire labels verbatim, joined with '; '; no invented Spanish wording. resp 2 = 'No' (CIS code 3). N.S. (8) and N.C. (9) are dropped by the .do: p1_1 1/0, p1_2 6/0, p1_3 1/2, p1_4 19/3 (total 32 person-item cells). No (NO LEER) middle code exists in this question. text_source=study_materials: instructions = the P.1 question stem verbatim from cues3565.pdf (pdftotext -layout); the interviewer directions '(RESPUESTA MÚLTIPLE). (RECOGER TODAS LAS QUE DIGA LA PERSONA ENTREVISTADA PARA CADA TIPO DE BIEN).' are not addressed to the respondent and are not shipped. item_text = the grid row labels verbatim; option_text = the grid column headers verbatim (the header 'Sí, lo ha adquirido otra persona de su hogar' is wrapped over three lines in the PDF and was joined; it matches the ES3565 label character for character). One trivial section_id. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only; every _translated field was written by IRW. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Household acquisition of durable goods in the last six months' matches P.1 exactly; no instrument mismatch. DICTIONARY DEFECT: the dictionary Reference reads 'Estudio sobre la situación internacional, Estudio 3564', but the dictionary's own URL, the processing script (3565_num.csv) and the data reproduce Estudio 3565, the May 2026 consumer-confidence study; the Reference should be corrected. RIGHTS: no block. Originator of the wording is CIS itself. instrument_rights_register.csv's CIS row is scoped in words to spain_2025_*; as in batches 322-324 the verdict was re-derived from CIS's reuse-conditions page, fetched 2026-09-23 (HTTP 200, sha256 3b15adb79f1443756583e5342faed973b472bde50f789284ba4ab7e1e16dc7a8; dynamic page, operative text re-read): 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales', 'La reutilización autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusión, modificación, adaptación, extracción, reordenación y combinación de la información', and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizándose la realización de actividades de reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública o transformación'. An affirmative grant; conditions are attribution, no distortion, no implied official character -- none a reserved right under irw#1945. No register row written. SIBLINGS: MD3565/cues3565.pdf also serve spain_2026_confidence_expectations and _macro (other agents this round) and _prospect/_retrospect (later); none of their files were touched.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only); resp 1 merges two administered answers, 'acquired it myself' and 'another household member acquired it' (respondents could mark both), which the IRW processing script combined into one 'yes' code, and 'don't know'/'no answer' (32 responses across the four goods) are treated as missing.

note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3565 VARIABLE LABELS (identical to 3565.sav variable labels) /P6 'Evolución del número de personas del entorno en paro y buscando trabajo (6 meses)', /P10 'Valoración prospectiva de la probabilidad de adquirir para el hogar bienes duraderos (1 año)', /P11 'Evolución de la capacidad de ahorro personal (1 año)'; VALUE LABELS P6 1 'Más' 2 'El mismo número' 3 'Menos' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'; P10 and P11 1 'Mayores' 2 'Iguales' 3 'Menores' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' CHECKED ANYWAY: re-running the .do logic on 3565_num.csv (id = row number, 8/9 to missing) reproduces the live table row for row: 8902 rows, id-item-resp sets identical (0/0 set differences; compared against the local irw cache copy made by table_context.R, no new export). Live item x resp at 1/2/3: p6 308/2325/297, p10 474/1689/812, p11 580/1301/1116. DROPPED CODES: only 8 N.S. and 9 N.C. -- p6 62/36, p10 37/16, p11 19/12 of 3028. Unlike the P7/P8/P9/P12 siblings, none of these three questions has a '(NO LEER)' middle category -- all three options are read aloud and the middle code 2 is retained, so the stored scale is 1,2,3 with no gap. text_source=study_materials: item_text transcribed verbatim from cues3565.pdf (pdftotext -layout), line breaks joined, question numbers and bracketed variable tags not shipped. P6 follows P.5 (count of unemployed people around the respondent) but its own wording carries its referent, so P.5 is not shipped. P10: the questionnaire prints an interviewer gloss inside the question block, '(ENTREVISTADOR/A:(*) Coches, muebles, electrodomésticos, ordenadores, etc. (Nunca viviendas, bienes inmuebles)).', keyed by '(*)' to 'bienes duraderos'; it is shipped verbatim in item_text (with the '(*)' marker) because it defines the item's referent, and it is marked as an interviewer note in the text itself -- a deviation from the sibling rule of dropping interviewer directions, disclosed here. instructions and section_prompt blank (three standalone questions; one trivial section_id). option_text is the questionnaire/value-label anchors verbatim (the two agree). translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3565 in Spanish only; all _translated columns written by IRW. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Personal expectations for unemployment, purchasing, and saving' matches P6 (unemployment around the respondent -- retrospective six-month change, not strictly an expectation), P10 and P11; no instrument mismatch. RIGHTS: no block. Originator of the wording is CIS. instrument_rights_register.csv's CIS 'allow' row (2026-09-22) is worded for spain_2025_*; as in batches 322-324 the verdict was re-derived from CIS's reuse-conditions page, fetched 2026-09-23 (HTTP 200, sha256 aa97f3a34e6a19444c635d226f8ac50c9e1bf4b0cf1a080c4207ff56567879e3; page not hash-stable, operative text re-read): reuse permitted 'con fines comerciales o no comerciales', 'La reutilización autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusión, modificación, adaptación, extracción, reordenación y combinación de la información', and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizándose la realización de actividades de reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública o transformación'. Conditions are attribution ('Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas'), no distortion, date of last update -- no reserved right under irw#1945. No register row written.
